rationale: Build on the current reverse-tail recurrent baseline with a compact curriculum change instead of another scalar sweep. The script now keeps the staged tail-recurrence ramp during most of training, but once quant-aware endgame training activates it switches training-time tail recurrence gains to full strength. This directly aligns late updates with the final exact eval/export path, targets the still-promising recurrence-scheduling category, stays compile-stable, and adds only a few lines without bloating the script.
title: Quant-Aware Full Tail Recurrence Endgame
